title: From Assistance to Human Capability: A Readout-Genesis Architecture for Proactive AI, Unequal Life Conditions, and Opportunity Conversion (RG-HCA)

equations.section: 2. Readout Genesis Is the Rail, Not a Metaphor
equations.text: S_n = (G_n, Lambda_n, T_n)
equations.meaning: The retained root state written schematically: a relational carrier, retained labels/typed distinctions, and an append-only tape.

equations.section: 2. Readout Genesis Is the Rail, Not a Metaphor
equations.text: S_(n+1) = F(S_n, u_n, c_n, T_n)
equations.meaning: Finite transition of the root state.

equations.section: 2. Readout Genesis Is the Rail, Not a Metaphor
equations.text: q#_(HCA,n+1) o F_n = F_(HCA,n) o q_(HCA,n)
equations.meaning: The candidate HCA domain must satisfy a declared weld (approximate commuting condition) with corresponding readout and invariant conditions.

equations.section: 2. Readout Genesis Is the Rail, Not a Metaphor
equations.text: S_n != Z_(HCA,n) != D_(HCA,n)
equations.meaning: Constitutional non-collapse: the retained root state, a candidate human-capability representation, and an empirically discovered sufficient quotient are different objects.

equations.section: 3. Internal Programme Lineage: The Native River Before Allies Are Attached
equations.text: Retained Difference -> Human Readout -> Live Problem -> Barrier Readout -> Candidate Routes -> Human Endorsement -> Adaptive Scaffold -> Practice -> Withdrawal -> Human Return -> Novel Transfer -> World Feedback -> Opportunity Conversion
equations.meaning: RG-HCA's own native river: the proactive-capability pipeline inherited and extended from the programme's prior interfaces.

equations.section: 5. Candidate HCA Domain State and Defect Discipline
equations.text: Z_(HCA,i,n) = < P^live_(i,n), K^life_(i,n), B^bar_(i,n), C^cand_(i,n), C^live_(i,n), h_(i,n), R^return_(H,i,n), Omega^real_(i,n) >
equations.meaning: Candidate HCA domain state for agent i at step n: live problem, life-context vector, barrier ledger, candidate/endorsed routes, assistance level, Human Return, and opportunity readout.

equations.section: 5. Candidate HCA Domain State and Defect Discipline
equations.text: epsilon_HCA = Def( q~_HCA o F, F_HCA o q~_HCA, O_HCA, Inv_HCA )
equations.meaning: A serious implementation must report a defect vector for the domain weld and be willing to delete variables that fail to add reproducible value.

equations.section: 6. Unequal Life Conditions: Capability Cannot Be Identified from the Conversation Alone
equations.text: K^life_(i,n) = < E^econ, F^base, L^lang, D^digital, T^disc, H^health, M^mob, N^mentor, C^cred >_(i,n)
equations.meaning: Life-Capital Context Vector: economic resources, foundational literacy, language bridge, device/connectivity, discretionary time, health, mobility/safety, mentor/network access, and credential pathway.

equations.section: 6. Unequal Life Conditions: Capability Cannot Be Identified from the Conversation Alone
equations.text: Resources != Access,  Access != Capability,  Capability != Realized Opportunity
equations.meaning: Three non-collapse laws separating resources, access, capability, and realized opportunity.

equations.section: 6. Unequal Life Conditions: Capability Cannot Be Identified from the Conversation Alone
equations.text: Access(z) != Control(z)
equations.meaning: Access to a resource is not the same as control over it.

equations.section: 6. Unequal Life Conditions: Capability Cannot Be Identified from the Conversation Alone
equations.text: Equal AI Access =/=> Equal Capability Conversion
equations.meaning: Equal access to AI does not entail equal conversion of that access into capability, given unequal life conditions.

equations.section: 7. Live Problem Entry and Barrier Readout
equations.text: B^bar_(i,n) subseteq {Knowledge, Skill, Language, Tool, ResourceTime, Network, Credential, Permission, Opportunity, Unknown}
equations.meaning: Typed barrier ledger inserted before any route or training prescription is proposed.

equations.section: 7. Live Problem Entry and Barrier Readout
equations.text: Observed Difficulty != Skill Deficit
equations.meaning: Load-bearing non-collapse: an observed difficulty must not be read by default as a personal skill deficit.

equations.section: 7. Live Problem Entry and Barrier Readout
equations.text: u*^diag_(i,n) = argmax_(u in U^diag) [ IG_B(u) - lambda_C Cost(u) - rho Risk(u) ]
equations.meaning: Candidate decisive-record policy for low-risk diagnostic actions that discriminate active barrier hypotheses, trading information gain against cost and risk; marked Open, to be replaced if a simpler rule performs as well.

equations.section: 8. Candidate Advancement Routes: Capability and Opportunity Are Different Objects
equations.text: C^cand_(i,n) = Gen( P^live_(i,n), B^bar_(i,n), K^life_(i,n), R^return_(H,i,n) )
equations.meaning: AI-generated candidate advancement routes (learning, access, or opportunity routes) once the barrier ledger is explicit.

equations.section: 8. Candidate Advancement Routes: Capability and Opportunity Are Different Objects
equations.text: C^live_(i,n) = { c in C^cand_(i,n) : Endorse_i(c) = 1 }
equations.meaning: The endorsed subset of candidate routes: AI may propose but not silently own the person's goal.

equations.section: 8. Candidate Advancement Routes: Capability and Opportunity Are Different Objects
equations.text: Proactive Suggestion != Human Goal Ownership
equations.meaning: First of three further non-collapse laws guarding proactive suggestion against silently overriding human agenda ownership.

equations.section: 8. Candidate Advancement Routes: Capability and Opportunity Are Different Objects
equations.text: Capability Advancement != AI Goal Authority
equations.meaning: Second non-collapse law: capability advancement does not confer AI authority over the person's goals.

equations.section: 8. Candidate Advancement Routes: Capability and Opportunity Are Different Objects
equations.text: Scaffolding != Control
equations.meaning: Third non-collapse law: adaptive scaffolding must not become control over the person.

equations.section: 9. The Proactive Human Capability Advancement Policy
equations.text: u*^adv_(i,n) = argmin_(u in U^adv) E[ (Res^cap_i + u)^2 + lambda_B B^use(u) + rho R_u + mu D_u + xi A_u + psi O_u - nu V_u ]
equations.meaning: Candidate domain-level proactive-support policy trading residual capability need against usability burden, task/safety risk, dependency risk, autonomy loss, opportunity cost, and transfer value; close in form to Genesis's epistemic-action policy but a domain proposal, not a root derivation. Marked Open.

equations.section: 9. The Proactive Human Capability Advancement Policy
equations.text: subject to: AgendaOwnership = 1, Endorsement = 1, Transparency = 1, Safety/Governance = 1
equations.meaning: Constraint set on the proactive-support policy (20): AI proactivity is gated by preserved agenda ownership, endorsement, transparency, and safety/governance.

equations.label: Human Capability Advancement Principle
equations.section: 9. The Proactive Human Capability Advancement Policy
equations.text: Human Capability Advancement Principle [Open]. When durable human development is an endorsed goal, AI may proactively identify and propose a reachable capability or opportunity expansion, but it should remain subordinate to human-owned ends, prefer the least burdensome intervention likely to produce durable return, and withdraw decisive support as the person demonstrates independent capability.
equations.meaning: Boxed governing principle constraining proactive capability advancement to remain subordinate to human-owned ends.

equations.section: 10. Adaptive Scaffolding: Use What the Learning Sciences Already Know, but Keep the Boundaries
equations.text: Stable Unaided Return (up) => h^decisive (down)
equations.meaning: Candidate monotonic fading rule: as stable unaided return rises, decisive assistance should fall, unless task difficulty, stakes, or domain risk rises. Marked Open.

equations.section: 10. Adaptive Scaffolding: Use What the Learning Sciences Already Know, but Keep the Boundaries
equations.text: Attempt -> Minimal Sufficient Scaffold -> Feedback -> Reattempt -> Fading -> Unaided Execution -> Novel Transfer
equations.meaning: The process for skill-building tasks once a route is endorsed and scaffolded.

equations.section: 11. Human Return: The AI Should Know When to Become Less Necessary
equations.text: R^return_H = < C, T, S, A >
equations.meaning: RG-HCA inherits CTSA Human Return: Conceptual, Tool-selection, Skill-execution, and Alternative-generation Return, evidenced by unaided reconstruction/selection/execution/generation under a declared criterion.

equations.section: 11. Human Return: The AI Should Know When to Become Less Necessary
equations.text: Delta Performance_AI > 0  =/=>  Delta R^return_H > 0
equations.meaning: Primary non-collapse: assisted-performance gain does not entail durable Human Return gain; a complete audit records gain, loss, provenance, warrant, and retained direction.

equations.section: 11. Human Return: The AI Should Know When to Become Less Necessary
equations.text: R^return_H (up) => h^decisive (down)
equations.meaning: For capability-sensitive tasks, decisive assistance should fall as Human Return rises, unless task difficulty, stakes, or domain risk rises; bounds the 'AI should make itself unnecessary' slogan away from a universal prohibition on delegation. Marked Open.

equations.section: 12. World Return: Capability That Never Leaves the Conversation Remains Unproven
equations.text: R^return_(H,i,n) -> a_(i,n) -> delta^world_(i,n+1) -> Z_(HCA,i,n+1)
equations.meaning: A human-selected action and the returned world record close the loop from Human Return back into the candidate HCA state, since an action-relevant live problem is not closed by verbal reconstruction alone.

equations.section: 13. Opportunity Conversion: The Market May Not Be Able to Read the Capability
equations.text: Omega^real_(i,n) = G_O( R^return_(H,i,n), K^life_(i,n), Cred_(i,n), Net_(i,n), Perm_(i,n), MarketReadout_n )
equations.meaning: World-side opportunity readout: realized opportunity is a joint readout of retained capability and conversion conditions, not a validated welfare utility function.

equations.section: 13. Opportunity Conversion: The Market May Not Be Able to Read the Capability
equations.text: Credential != Capability
equations.meaning: First of two further essential non-collapses, motivated by Spence's signalling model: a recognizable credential is not the same as demonstrated capability.

equations.section: 13. Opportunity Conversion: The Market May Not Be Able to Read the Capability
equations.text: Market Legibility != Human Worth
equations.meaning: Second non-collapse: capability not legible to gatekeepers may fail to become opportunity, but this does not make it less real human worth.

equations.section: 13. Opportunity Conversion: The Market May Not Be Able to Read the Capability
equations.text: Skill -> Evidence of Skill -> Recognition -> Opportunity
equations.meaning: A full advancement route to realized opportunity, which can fail at any transition.

equations.section: 14. Worked Scenario: Three Children, Unequal Starting Conditions, and the Age-15 Boundary
equations.text: Outcome_C - Outcome_A  !=  Effect_HCA
equations.meaning: Causal warning in the three-children (A/B/C) worked scenario: a raw outcome gap between differently-resourced children is not the causal effect of HCA, since C also receives more schooling and credential access.

equations.section: 14. Worked Scenario: Three Children, Unequal Starting Conditions, and the Age-15 Boundary
equations.text: Schooling + Human-Owned Inquiry + Supervised Adaptive AI + Projects + Human Return + Opportunity Bridges
equations.meaning: The strongest suggested pathway from the scenario, interpreted as readiness for safe entry-level work/apprenticeship/vocational transition, not a recommendation to end education.

equations.section: 15. Child and Adult Governance: Proactivity Without Paternalism
equations.text: Purpose + Transparency + Refusal + Revision + Data Minimization
equations.meaning: Minimum governance bundle for adult deployment.

equations.section: 15. Child and Adult Governance: Proactivity Without Paternalism
equations.text: Child Assent + Adult Oversight + Privacy + Safety + No Opaque Persuasion (+ Age-Appropriate Design)
equations.meaning: Stronger governance gate required for child deployment, per UNESCO/UNICEF guidance.

equations.section: 16. Measurement Architecture: What Would Count as Advancement?
equations.text: A^HCA_i = < Gain_CTSA, Loss, Transfer, Ownership, Burden, BarrierChange, OpportunityChange, Provenance, Warrant >
equations.meaning: Candidate net advancement record separating six outcome families (immediate performance, Human Return, transfer, autonomy, burden/adoption, opportunity conversion); a Pareto report is preferred over a single scalar score.

equations.section: 17.6 Identification discipline
equations.text: ATE_HCA(x) = E[ Y(1) - Y(0) | K^life = x ]
equations.meaning: Conditional average treatment estimand for policy comparison under unequal starting conditions; x is a declared baseline life-context stratum, and matching/covariate adjustment is a design strategy, not part of the estimand.
